## [V3.885] — 2026-10-23 — Scientia: a note's details live in its first block — nothing asked up front; templates swap in place

Plan: [CodeLog/ClaudesPlan/V3.885_scientia_note_details_in_first_block.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.885_scientia_note_details_in_first_block.md). Web build only; `scientia/src` untouched; no backend change. Supersedes V3.882's *Save to a project…* form and V3.880's blank-page template bar.

### Changed
- **The note's first block holds its details** (`lab-mode.js`, `DocView.headBox` wrapped → `headFields`): Title, Type, Template (No template / each type's standard / the person's own, grouped by type), Project (*No project — a quick note* / *Assigned to you* / *Your projects*), Theme (the project's active themes; disabled for a project-wide type), and *Seen by* in an RM project — always editable; Gabe's ✎ dialog stays for the date and delete.
- **Making a note asks nothing**: `App.newDoc` (+ Note, Ctrl+Alt+N, links, a project's + Note), `CHAIN.start` (+ Experiment) and ＋ Quick note create at once with the type's template (`markTemplate` tags its items) and open the note; `pre.runDef` (running a registered protocol) keeps Gabe's dialog.
- **Templates swap in place**: template items carry `tpl { id, label0, text0 }` (`isEdited`: label / text / marks changed, or no longer a component). Untouched → `swapTemplate(docId, tplId)` replaces them at once (type follows the template; a default title follows the type). Edited → Gabe's `modal`: **Keep the items I edited** (kept ones lose `tpl` and become the person's; the untouched go; the new template's items are placed beside the kept, `at = right of them`), **Replace everything**, Cancel (the picker is restored, also on Escape — `onClose`). Items the person added are never touched. Changing the Type of an untouched note brings that type's template (`changeType`). `setProject / setTheme / setTitle` write and ask the hub for RM's notes list when it matters (V3.880's `noteSig` kick).
- *Seen by* moved from the title line into the first block; the Quick notes cards lose *Save to a project…* (the note's own block holds the project).

### Tests
- Lab-mode harness 148/148: + Quick note / + Note / + Experiment open at once with no dialog; the block's five fields; template chosen → items + type; swapped freely while untouched; edited → the question; Cancel restores; Keep places the new items beside the kept one; Replace everything removes edits but never the person's own item; Type brings its template; title / project (RM notes list asked) / theme set in the block; Seen by in the block.

## [V3.884] — 2026-10-23 — One recorder, part 1: marks and pause on the boards, Scientia recordings saved a minute at a time, ink timed with the voice; the My Week report popup always closes

Program plan: [CodeLog/ClaudesPlan/V3.884_one_recorder_program.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.884_one_recorder_program.md) — RM's board recorder (voice + timed ink + replay) and Scientia's Recording component (marks + transcripts) become one recorder. Decision (Alex): cloud speech-to-text = Google Speech-to-Text, **on a button that shows its likely cost first** (R3). Backend deployed first (`scientiaHub` health `V3.884`; Storage join verified live with a throwaway id, cleaned up).

### Added
- **`rm/js/recorder-core.js`** (`RECORDER_CORE`, DOM-free, node + browser): mark kinds `important · question · decision · todo` (`MARK_KINDS`, glyphs ◆ ? ◇ ☐), `normMark / addMark / openSection / closeSection / toggleSection / openOf / marksAt / markLabel` (a mark is `{ id, t, kind, label, end? }` — no end = a moment, `null` = an open section); `audioToWall / wallToAudio` around `gap` events; `lineAt(segs, t)`; `stamp / momentOf / strokesAt` (a Scientia stroke's `rt = [recId, t0, t1]`); `sttCost(sec)` (`STT_USD_PER_MIN` 0.016, started minutes, "48¢" / "$1.20"); `partName`, `mmss`. 8 node fixtures `scripts/tests/recorder-core.test.cjs` (in `run-all.sh`).
- **Board recorder** (`whiteboard.js`): while recording, ✦ Tools offers ❚❚ Pause / ▶ Resume (`recPause / recResume`; a pause is logged as a `gap` event with `reason: 'pause'`, so the replay's audio ↔ wall rule skips it; a paused recording does not time out; the tab-return auto-resume leaves a person's pause alone), four kinds of mark (`recMark(kind)`) and an important section (`recSection`); `Alt+M` marks (Scientia's key), `Alt+P` pauses. Marks are `marks[]` on the recording doc (`marksClock: 'wall'`, seconds since the start), saved 400 ms after a change and at Stop (an open section is closed there). The shared core loads with the first recording (`ensureRecCore`). The pill clock shows ❚❚ while paused. Harness `scripts/tests/v3884-recorder-harness.html` (16, fake microphone).
- **Scientia recordings on the web** (`rm/scientia/lab-mode.js` §12): the audio goes to the lab's cloud a part a minute while it records (`sendPart` → `POST api/rec/part`), joined at Stop (`api/rec/compose`) — a closed tab loses at most a minute and a recording may pass the 30 MB single-file cap; under a minute it is one file as before; an interrupted recording offers **Recover them** (`recoverParts`). The component gains a row of marks (four kinds + ⟦ Section ⟧, at the moment recording or playing), the marks list shows each kind and a section's span, sections are bands on the progress bar. Ink drawn in the note while it records is stamped with its moment (`INK.penDown / INK.addStroke` wrapped; `stroke.rt`) and the card counts it.
- **Hub** (`functions/scientia-hub*.js`): `api/rec/part` (Storage `recparts/<rid>/part-NNNN.<ext>`), `api/rec/parts` (count + bytes), `api/rec/compose` (Storage `combine`, 32 at a time through temporaries, a free `recordings/` name, download token, media doc, parts deleted); `MemoryHub` twins; fixture (in order, any length, names, bad input).

### Changed
- `api/rec/status` on the hub answers `{ ok: true, state: 'saved' }` — a final answer, so the web app stops asking every 3 s (it polled forever while a recording sat at `queued`); the card says "Saved in the lab's cloud" and that cloud speech-to-text will show its cost first. `cloud-sync.js` maps a joined recording's URL at once.

### Bug Fixes
- **The My Week report popup ("Report as the result of…") would not go away** when it was opened for a Scientia component: it closed only on a click in the host page or Escape, and the next click landed inside the Scientia frame, which the page never hears. It now has a **×**, closes on a click inside any same-origin frame on the page (`watchFrames`), and on the window losing focus to a frame (`onWinBlur`). (`rm/js/myweek-report.js`, `rm/css/canvas-widgets.css`; harness `v3854-canvas-report-harness.html` 36/36 + 34/34 mobile.)

### Tests
- Hub fixtures 60/60 · recorder core 8/8 · board recorder harness 16/16 · Scientia lab-mode harness 146/146 · notebook host 45/45 · board harnesses unchanged (v3830 26/26 + 9/9, v3839 77/77, v3833 65/65).

## [V3.883] — 2026-10-23 — Inventory and procurement work together: six seams fixed, tested as journeys across both pages

Alex: *"lets make sure that the inventory and procruement work together well. do multiple tests to ensure that all the
different user workflows will be easy and seemless."* Plan:
[V3.883_inventory_procurement_together.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.883_inventory_procurement_together.md). FTP only.

**Baseline first, all green and still green after:** procurement core 287 → 298, custom items 69, labels 20, use
plans 29, qty dial 25, user actions 18; emulator: inventory rules 59, procurement rules 162, inventory E2E 96,
procurement E2E 96; browser: procurement 227, custom inventory 54, pills 25, scan-take 48. None of them followed a
person from one page to the other, which is where every problem below was.

### Added
- **`scripts/tests/v3883-inventory-procurement-journeys.html`**: the REAL `procurement.js` and the REAL `inventory.js`
  (with inventory-qty / -use / -made, qty-picker, forms, procurement-core), each in its own iframe
  (`scripts/tests/fixtures/journey-procurement.html`, `journey-inventory.html`), sharing ONE in-memory Firestore
  (transactions, batches, merge sets, `where` / `orderBy` / `limit`, server stamps, `arrayUnion`) and Storage. Values
  cross frames as JSON with dates revived in the reading frame. Personas: student, PI, purchaser, inventory manager,
  member; a persona switch reloads the frame. Links are followed as written (the card's *open in inventory*, the
  panel's *Request reorder* and *view it*). Six journeys, **49 checks**, each journey isolated: (1) a new thing from
  request to inventory, PO and receipt filed, consumable, location tidied, scan goes straight to the dial; (5) the
  receipts one click from the item; (2) reorder from the inventory panel, prefilled, then *already requested* on the
  panel, in the form and in Reorder existing; (3) Reorder existing without custom items, "low" the same on both pages;
  (4) restock untracked (same location), tracked by a member (count kept, warned), by an inventory manager (count raised,
  `add` row); (6) a custom item made from the item just bought (*whole packages* off its Qty column).
  **Run against the pre-change code (served from a scratch copy, the repo untouched) it fails 15 checks, one at every
  seam fixed below**, and passes 49/49 on this build. `?stop=1|2|3|4` stops after a journey for a screenshot.
- `procurement-core.js` `tidyLocation(s)`, `openRequestsFor(tickets, item)` (live requests linked by `inventoryItemId`,
  else by vendor + name; newest first), `requestLine(t)` ("Ordered · PO PO-77 · ETA … · 2 requested · by Sam").
  11 new core checks.
- **Inventory panel → *Procurement*** (`procurementHtml(item)` in `inventory.js`, bought items only): *Already
  requested: …* for each open request, *Bought through a request (date) — view it and its receipts*
  (`procurementTicketId`), *Last restocked through a request on … — view it* (`last_procurement_ticket_id`), each
  linking `procurement.html?ticket=`. The page loads `procurement/tickets.json` (optional) and `procurement-core.js`.
- **Procurement:** the reorder composer (from the panel, `?reorder=`, Reorder existing, Request again) shows *Already
  requested:* with links before anyone submits a second request; Reorder existing badges an inventory row *already
  requested* / *approved to order* / *on order* / *arrived, not put away*.

### Bug Fixes
- **A thing put away from a request was not a consumable** (`newInventoryItem` set no `is_consumable`), so every
  member's scan of it asked "per use or package?". Now consumable for `consumable` and `research_*`, with
  `condition: 'active'`, `subcategory: ''`, `stock_status` `full` / `n/a`, as inventory's own *+ Add Item* does.
- **Location spellings split**: put-away kept "Freezer A  /  drawer 2" as typed, and a restock to "freezer a / drawer
  2" added a second location beside "Freezer A/drawer 2". `tidyLocation` now applies to the new item, the restock
  match, the request's own `location` and the put-away suggestions.
- **Custom items were offered for reorder**: `catalogue()` (Reorder existing) and `searchInventory()` (the put-away
  restock search) now skip `lab_made`.
- **"Low" disagreed between the pages**: `stockOf()` used only `qty_min`; it now mirrors `INV_QTY.severity` (explicit
  minimum, else ≤ 20 % of `qty_made`), so FBS at 50 of 500 mL is low in Reorder existing as in the inventory.
- **Nothing stopped a second request** for an item already on order (the panel, the scan toast's *Request a reorder*,
  Reorder existing): now said on both pages, with the request.
- **An item never showed where it came from**, so its request (PO, receipts) was unreachable from the inventory.

### Changed
- `rm/pages/inventory.html` loads `procurement-core.js`; `rm/css/procurement.css` `.pt-pk-badge--open`,
  `.pt-already`.
- `sw.js` CACHE_VERSION 866 → 867.

- **Open-note tabs** (`rm/js/notebook-scientia.js`): the Scientia group lists the notes OPEN in this browser (`localStorage nbc_sis_open`, seeded with the 6 most recent; `openIds / openTab / closeTab`) instead of the 20 most recent; a note opened anywhere (tab, Portfolio, a link, inside Scientia) joins; every tab has an × (`.nbc-tab-x`, `data-t="sis-close"`) — closing the note on screen moves to the next open tab or Today; a search still lists every matching note. **＋ Quick note** (`.nbc-sis-quick`, `data-t="sis-quick"`) after the tabs sends `sisCmd: 'quick'`; lab-mode answers it once the app is mounted (`App._mounted`).
- **The canvas pills** (`lab-mode.js` §11): ✎ the hand (first arc zoom · move · pen · highlighter · lasso; second arc per mode — Gabe's ink colours + *Add a colour* (≤ 3 kept per device, `_ls lab:inkColors`, appended to `INK.COLORS`), eraser, three widths, pressure, undo / redo; zoom in / out / 100 % / fit), ＋ Insert (the most used `INSERTS` — component, lab paper, material, RM protocol, run, plate, task, *Something I did*, collection — placed at the view's centre; *…* = `INSERT.menu`), ✦ Tools (timer start / pause / resume via `TCMP.start` / `TIMER`, `CALC.open`, `EQ.newMenu`, Gabe's ink bar, `App.toggleFocus`, put the pills back), ⊕ View (in · 100 % · out · fit; the zoom % follows every move — `Paper.prototype.apply` wrapped). The hand is read back from `INK` (`handNow()`: `INK.mouse` off = move; on = `INK.tool`); zoom is ours (`bindZoomHand`: a tap ×1.5 at the point, Alt / Shift / right button out, a vertical drag zooms smoothly). Pills drag anywhere (`_ls lab:pills` fractions), the fan uses RM's rings (`fanPos`), other pills fade while one is open, a tap outside closes it, a double tap on ✎ = the last mode (`lastHand`). Monochrome inline SVGs from the site's Heroicons set (+ a drawn lasso). Default column on the left middle — clear of Gabe's timer card, dock and Next button.

### Bug Fixes

## [V3.881] — 2026-10-23 — Procurement: load receipts and requisition printouts, kept for a later read into the inventory

Alex: *"on the procurement page, we need a way for the person doing the procurement to load in the receipt or
requisition printout to the site, later we can collect these and use them to auto injest the items into the
inventory."* Plan: [V3.881_procurement_receipts_requisitions.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.881_procurement_receipts_requisitions.md).

**Deployed first:** `firestore:rules` from a scratch copy = the LIVE ruleset + only the `procurementDocs` block (diffed:
35 lines added, none removed; the rules suite run against that copy: 162 ok). The repo file's other undeployed hunks
stay undeployed: V3.806's `users` self-role guard, the V3.836 comment renames, and V3.835's inventory `use_mode` line.
That last one must not ship as written: `inventory-use.js` writes `use_mode: 'package'` on a member's first scan of a
consumable with no mode set, which the line would refuse. No Storage rules change (`procurement/{docId}/**` already
covers `procurement/docs/…`).

### Added
- **`procurementDocs/{docId}`**: one record per uploaded file: `kind` (receipt | requisition | invoice | packing_slip
  | po | quote | other), `fileName`, `contentType`, `size`, `storagePath` (`procurement/docs/{docId}/{name}`), `url`,
  `ticketIds[]` (≤ 50), `poNumber`, `vendor`, `docDate`, `note`, `source` (upload | order | receive), `uploadedBy`,
  `uploadedByName`, `uploadedAt`, `updatedAt`, and **`ingestStatus: 'pending'`** with `ingestedAt`,
  `ingestedItemIds[]`, `ingestNote` reserved for the later step that reads them into the inventory.
- `firestore.rules` `match /procurementDocs/{docId}`: read any lab member; create `uploadedBy == self`, known kind,
  path under `procurement/docs/{docId}/`, ≤ 50 requests, `ingestStatus == 'pending'`, and a purchaser / approver /
  admin, or any member when the file covers a request (the Receive form); update by purchaser / approver / admin or
  the uploader, only the labels, links and `ingest*` fields; delete by an admin or the uploader. 26 new cases in
  `procurement-rules.test.mjs` (162 ok).
- `rm/js/procurement-core.js`: `DOC_KINDS`, `DOC_KIND_IDS`, `DOC_MAX_BYTES`, `DOC_MAX_TICKETS`, `docKindLabel`,
  `docContentType(name, type)` (a typeless phone HEIC → `image/heic`), `checkDocFile(file)` (PDF or image, non-empty,
  < 20 MB), `safeFileName`, `docStoragePath`, `orderSiblings(t, tickets)` (same `orderGroupId` or PO #),
  `docLinkCandidates(tickets, now)` (approved / ordered / arrived + put away in 60 days), `buildDocRecord(o)` (deduped
  links; a blank PO # / vendor taken from the linked requests when they agree), `docEditPatch`, `docsForTicket`,
  `legacyAttachments(tickets, docs)` (V3.813 `poUrl` / `receiptUrl` with no record, as read-only rows), `docRows`,
  `searchDocs`. 22 new checks in `procurement-core.test.mjs` (287).
- `rm/js/procurement.js`: **a Receipts tab** (`docs`, purchasers / approvers / admins): a drop zone + "choose files"
  (any number; PDF or photo; each checked before upload, a bad one marked in red and refused), then *What are they?*,
  PO #, vendor (both with suggestions), date, note and **Which requests do they cover?** (search, tick; ticking fills a
  blank PO # / vendor); **Upload N files**. Below: every document newest first (kind chip, the file, date · vendor ·
  PO, *Not yet in inventory*, the requests it covers as links, who uploaded it), the V3.813 request files as legacy
  rows, the top search box searching them, **Edit** (labels and links, inline) and **Delete** (uploader or admin; asks
  in the row). `uploadDoc(file, meta)` puts the file with an explicit content type and writes the record; a failed
  record removes the file unless the caller keeps it.
- On a request card: **Receipts & documents** (its files, for everyone who sees the request) and, for purchasers /
  approvers from approved to put away, **Attach receipt / requisition**: inline kind + files + note, ticked by default
  to link the other requests on the same order.
- `rm/css/procurement.css`: drop zone, chosen-file rows, the request picker, document rows, the card list.
- `v3813-procurement-selftest.html` 225 → 227 checks pass, with a new *Receipts & requisitions* section (a student sees
  a request's files but has no Attach; the purchaser's Receipts tab: a spreadsheet refused, a typeless HEIC filed as
  `image/heic`, a request linked and its PO # filled, search, edit, delete asked in the row, Attach on a card linking
  the order's other request).

### Changed
- The **Order** form's PO and the **Receive** form's receipt go through `uploadDoc` (to `procurement/docs/…`, with a
  record linked to every request on the order) and still set `poUrl` / `receiptUrl` on the request; if the record cannot
  be written the request keeps the file and a warning says so. `uploadFile` is gone.
- The stub in `v3813-procurement-selftest.html` gains `orderBy` / `limit`; its PO-path check expects
  `procurement/docs/{docId}/…`; the purchaser's actions on an approved request include `attach`; tab lists include
  `docs`.
- The documents load is wrapped so even a synchronous throw costs only that list, never the page.
- `sw.js` CACHE_VERSION 862 → 864 (863 left for the Scientia session's V3.880).

### Known
- `storage.rules` gives `procurement/**` no delete path, so deleting a document removes its record (and it leaves the
  list and its requests) but the file stays in Storage. Same for the rare rollback when a record fails to write.
- Pre-existing: Storage `procurement/**` is readable by any signed-in account, guests included, so anyone holding a
  file's link can open it.

## [V3.880] — 2026-10-23 — Scientia Portfolio: what the PI assigned comes first, as movable region cards; quick notes; notes filed under RM work listed in RM

Plan: [CodeLog/ClaudesPlan/V3.880_scientia_portfolio_regions_quick_notes.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.880_scientia_portfolio_regions_quick_notes.md). Web build only; `scientia/src` untouched. Backend deployed first (rules from LIVE + this block, two indexes, `scientiaHub`, health `V3.880`).

### Added
- **The person's assignments → Scientia projects** (`functions/scientia-hub-core.js`): `rmAssigned({ foci, projects, uid })` turns every approved `researchFoci` card and every `projects` doc with the person in `member_uids` into a project row (`rm-f-<card>` / `rm-p-<project>`; `rm, rmSource, rmId, rmKind, rmStatus, rmRole, rmLine, rmParents, rmUrl, rmDraftId, rmAssigned`). An aim under an assigned grant becomes a THEME of that grant's project (`rm-a-<aim>`, question = its one-liner). An RM project a card already stands for (`source_draft_id`, `links.draft_refs`, `grant_meta.promoted_draft_id`) folds into the card. `planAssigned({ state, rows, assigned, now })` owns only `PROJECT_FIELDS` / `THEME_FIELDS`; unassigning keeps the row (`rmAssigned: false`) and retires an aim theme with `UNASSIGNED_WHY` (restored when reassigned; a theme the person re-shaped keeps its status). `FirestoreHub.syncProjects` (two `array-contains` queries + parent titles), device "RM projects", throttled 5 min (`projSyncAt`), in `quietSyncs` as `projects`.
- **Notes index for RM** (`functions/scientia-hub-core.js`): `noteLink`, `notePreview` (≤ 40 live components × 600 chars, object markers dropped), `planNoteLinks`, `noteIndexId(uid, docId)`. `FirestoreHub.syncNotes` keeps `scientiaNotes/{uid}__{docId}` for every note filed in an RM project (`rmIds` = the project's RM id + the aim's + the grant draft's), incremental from `noteCursor` (a projects/themes op → full pass), throttled 2 min (`noteSyncAt`), in `quietSyncs` as `notes`; `visibility` = `'lab'` when the owner shares the note (`doc.share === 'lab'`, with the preview), else `'private'` (no text).
- **`firestore.rules` `scientiaNotes/{noteId}`**: read if `isLabMember()` and (`visibility == 'lab'` or `ownerUid == auth.uid`) — not the PI for a private note; no client writes. 13-case emulator test `scripts/tests/scientia-notes-rules.test.mjs` (also run against the deployed LIVE + block copy). Indexes `(rmIds CONTAINS, visibility)` and `(rmIds CONTAINS, ownerUid)`.
- **`rm/js/scientia-notes.js`** (`SCIENTIA_NOTES`): `mount(el, { rmId, empty })` lists a card's notebooks (the lab's shared ones + my own, two provable queries) with who can read each; `decorate(root)` puts a "Notebooks N" chip on every `[data-item-id]` card (projects.html, where paper items open the builder instead of expanding); my note opens in the Lab Notebook (`?notebook=scientia&note=`), someone else's shared note opens read-only in place. Mounted in `research.js` (card detail and the grant review, `[data-sis-notes]`) and `projects.js` (expanded item + chips). Harness `scripts/tests/v3880-scientia-notes-harness.html` (13/13).
- **Lab layer §10** (`rm/scientia/lab-mode.js`): `PortfolioView.render` replaced by `renderPortfolio` — regions in the order assigned (by kind, then name) → Quick notes → own projects → earlier assignments (folded). A region = header (kind · status · assigned · role, the one-liner, "builds on", + Note, Open in RM) + themes as columns with Gabe's `tcard` / `dcard`; `dragRegion` moves it by its header (edge panning), `toggleRegion` folds it; flow layout until the first move, which pins every region (`_ls` `lab:portfolio` `{ pinned, pos, open }`); `tidy()`; `drawLinks()` redraws the dashed note links between cards wherever they are (a folded region stands for its notes). A toolbar: + Project, + Quick note, Tidy up, Refresh from RM (`api/rm/sync?only=projects`).
- **Quick notes**: `quickNote()` makes a General note (`type 'note'`, no project, `quick: true`) and opens it; while blank (`blankDoc`) a bar offers `templateRows()` (enabled standard templates + the person's own) — `applyTemplate(docId, t)` turns the page into that type in place (the empty component takes the first row) — and *Continue blank*; typing puts it away. *Add to project…* on every quick-note card and in the bar uses Gabe's `GENERAL.move`, so the note is then stored in that project.
- **"Seen by"** on a note in an RM project (the note's header): *Only me* (default, `share: 'me'`) / *Lab members* (`share: 'lab'`); `setShare`. A change to a note's project, theme, title or sharing asks the hub for `notes` at once (`kickRm(kinds)`, which now takes the syncs to run).

### Changed
- The project page of an assigned project shows its RM line (kind, status, assigned to you, the one-liner, Open in RM / Open the draft) and hides *Rename* — the name is RM's.
- `kickRm()` → `kickRm(kinds)` (default `['when', 'activity']`, so V3.874 callers are unchanged); `KICK.onlys` records what was asked.
- `CodeLog/features.json`: `scientia.portfolio` decision resolved (status active); `rm/js/scientia-notes.js` registered under `scientia.cloud` (related `rm.research`, `rm.projects`).

### Tests
- Hub fixtures 59/59 (`functions/test/scientia-hub.test.js`: assignment mirror, unassign/reassign, the person's own fields surviving, the notes index — default private, shared preview, a quick note filed after the fact, moved out, deleted).
- Lab-mode harness 109/109 (`scripts/tests/v3869-scientia-lab-mode-harness.html` §14: region order, header, aim columns, folded earlier assignment, links, flow → move pins → fold leaves others → survives leaving → Tidy; project page; quick note → template / Continue blank / typing; Seen by → notes kick; Add to project… from the card).

## [V3.879] — 2026-10-23 — Inventory: category pills replace the tab bar and the filter dropdowns

Alex: *"on the lab inventory page, i dont like the top row of filters, these are not commonly used. we should have a set
of pills for each category, and by default all but consumables, research are off."* Plan:
[V3.879_inventory_category_pills.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.879_inventory_category_pills.md). FTP only.

### Added
- **Category pills** (`#inv-pills`, `rm/js/inventory.js`): `INV_PILLS` — Research, Consumables, Custom, Equipment,
  Computers & Software, Furniture & Office, Infrastructure, Other — any number on at once. `invPillOf(item)` puts every
  item in exactly one (custom first, then `research_*`, `consumable`, `equipment`, `computer`/`software`,
  `lab_furniture`/`office`, `infrastructure`, else Other, so nothing is unreachable). **On by default: Research and
  Consumables** (`INV_PILLS_DEFAULT`). Each pill shows its count; an empty group is hidden unless on. After a divider,
  **Low or out** and **Preferred** narrow whatever is shown (`_invIsLow`, `_invIsPreferred`), keeping what those two
  tabs did.
- `_invLoadPills` / `_invSavePills` — the choice is remembered per viewer in `localStorage` `rm.inventory.pills.v1`
  (`{on, low, preferred}`, unknown keys dropped, every access in try/catch; blocked storage = the defaults each visit).
  Only the person's clicks are saved.
- `_invReveal(item)` — `invHandleScan` (desktop) and `_invOpenItem` (`?item=`, a just-made custom item) turn the item's
  pill on **for this visit only** and lift the narrowing pills, so a filter never hides what was asked for.
- `_invHiddenMatches()` / `invShowHidden()` — a search that matches items in groups that are off says *"N more matches
  in Equipment and Other, which are off."* with **Show them** (turns those on, saved), above the list or in place of
  the empty state.
- `scripts/tests/v3879-inventory-pills-selftest.html` — 25 checks on the real `inventory.js` (and the real page's
  markup and CSS): default pills and counts, hidden empty groups, toggling and saving, subcategories only with one
  pill on, Low or out / Preferred, everything off, the hidden-matches line and Show them, an opened item revealed but
  not saved, blocked storage.

### Changed
- `getFiltered()`: pills → narrowing → subcategory (only while exactly one category pill is on) → search
  (`_invMatchesSearch`, unchanged fields). `render()` paints the pills (fresh counts on every repaint);
  `_invPaintChrome()` is now just `render()`. The subcategory buttons follow the single pill that is on.
- `rm/pages/inventory.html`: **All Categories ▾ and All Stock ▾ removed**; the tab bar `#tabs` becomes `#inv-pills`;
  pill CSS (filled = on; sideways scroll under 640 px).
- Removed: `TABS`, `activeTab`, `updateTabActive`, the two dropdown handlers.
- `v3875-custom-inventory-selftest.html` follows the pills (Custom is off by default; the test turns it on), still 54.
- `sw.js` CACHE_VERSION 861 → 862.

dropdown. / there should also be an option for a group of items for example a user could me 4 15mL tubes of LLS these
should all be palced in the same locaiton. / we should be able to consume something in the inventory to make an
alliquot of something or to make custom media etc. … Be careful about consumption since some things we have qr codes
for packs of items, but here the user may mark down 4 15mL tubes were consumed, that should not mean 4 packs of 15 mL
tubes."* Plan: [V3.875_custom_inventory_made_from.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.875_custom_inventory_made_from.md). FTP only:
no rules, index or function change (members may already write a delta-0 or negative-delta `use` row and update an
untracked item's `quantity`).

### Added
- **`rm/js/inventory-made.js`** — `INV_MADE_CORE` (DOM-free; `module.exports` for node): `TYPES` (`aliquot` Custom
  aliquot, `material` Custom material, `media` Custom media; V3.873 `made_in_lab` reads as material), `typeOf(item)`
  ('' for anything bought, even with subcategory `media`), `typeLabel`, `unitWord` / `amountText` (plurals, µL),
  `tidyLocation`, `locationNames`, `stockText` ("counted in mL · 450 left" / "not counted (Qty 3)"),
  **`unitChoices(item)`** (the first choice is the default and cannot over-subtract: a `pack` / `box` / `ea` item
  offers *single pieces from an open pack* first, then whole units as counted; a measure item its family; a container
  item that container, plus volumes when it has `each_amount`; an untracked item *pieces*, *whole packages, as the Qty
  column counts them* when Qty is a number, and measures), **`planIngredient(item, amount, unit)`** → `{take, via:
  'qty'|'legacy'|'note', qty, unit, takeQty, takeUnit, before, after, over, reason, text}` or `{error}` — subtracts only
  an amount exact in the item's own `qty_unit` (same-family measures convert; a group's measure that is a whole number
  of containers becomes containers; whole packages off an untracked Qty column only when chosen); single pieces of a
  pack, part of a container, cross-family units and anything untracked are **noted** with a reason (`pieces` | `part` |
  `mismatch` | `untracked`); below zero is allowed and said; `groupLine(v)`, `labelCount(v)` (one per container,
  capped at 100), `validate(v, rows)` → `[{field, row?, message}]` (a location of only slashes fails), `buildItem(v,
  who, today)` (`subcategory: 'custom_<type>'`, id `<type>-<date>-<name>`, a counted batch tracked in its container or
  measure, `each_amount` / `each_unit` for containers only, `composition: []`), `compositionEntry(item, plan)` →
  `{itemId, name, kind, qty, unit, taken, taken_qty, taken_unit, note}`, `search(pool, q, limit, skipIds)` (every word,
  name-prefix first, retired/lost out).
- `INV_MADE.open({items, chemicals, create, opened})` — its own form (`.imd-*` CSS injected): a desktop modal whose
  fields scroll under a pinned Cancel / Save, or the app's bottom sheet. **How many** is one row: count + a units
  `<select>` (Containers: tubes … pieces; Amount: µL … g) + *each holds* amount + unit (hidden for an amount); the kind
  sets the starting unit (media → bottles) until the person picks one; the group line and label count update live.
  **Made from**: search items, custom items and chemicals (`api.load('inventory/chemicals.json')` on first focus) →
  a row per ingredient with how it is counted, an amount, `unitChoices`, and the plan in words (green taken, amber
  below zero, grey noted). Errors sit beside their field or row and take the focus; a failed create stays in the form
  footer. After save: each ingredient through `INV_QTY.consume` (`via 'qty'`, in the item's unit, `purpose:
  'lab-made:<id>'`, `context: 'lab-made'`) or `noteOrLegacy` (one transaction, live `before`; `legacy` patches
  `quantity` and writes a row with `legacy: true`, refusing if the item became tracked; `note` writes `delta: 0` in the
  person's unit), both with `madeItemId`; then `INV_LABELS.queue` (one copy per container) or `ensureCode`; one toast
  lists the code, labels, what was taken off and what was noted, a second any failures.
- The item panel: **Made from** (`madeFromHtml`: each line "(N taken off)" or "(noted, not taken off)", linking to
  ingredients still in the list) and **Each tube holds 15 mL**.
- `scripts/tests/inventory-made.test.mjs` (69: the case table, defaults never take packs, builder, labels, validation,
  search) and `scripts/tests/v3875-custom-inventory-selftest.html` (46 against the real form and the real `INV_QTY`
  write: 4 tubes from a pack noted with the pack count unchanged and a delta-0 ledger row, 50 mL FBS 450 → 400, a DMEM
  package 3 → 2, a chemical noted, a missing amount stopped beside its row, recipe stored, 4 labels, the panel lines);
  replaces `v3873-lab-made-selftest.html`. `inventory-labels.test.mjs` 19 → 20.

### Changed
- `rm/js/inventory.js`: `addLabMadeItem()` opens `INV_MADE.open` (the V3.873 `openForm` form, `_invLabelNewItem`,
  `_invTidyLocation`, `_invLocationSuggestions`, `_invLocalToday` and the `LAB_MADE_*` constants are gone); the tab is
  **Custom Items**; `SUBTAB_LABELS` gains `custom_aliquot` / `custom_material` / `custom_media`; the chip reads

- `rm/pages/inventory.html`: **+ Custom item**; loads `inventory-made.js` before `inventory.js`.

## [V3.873] — 2026-10-23 — Lab members add aliquots and things we make in the lab, each with its own QR code

Alex: *"in the inventory, i want users to be able to add alliquots and custom inventory that we make in the lab… users
will name this accordingly, we dont need to make anything custom for these, but users should describe custom items so
we know about them, also they should say where they live for example fridge/box/001"*, then *"these custom inventory
items should also get a qr code"*. Plan: [V3.873_lab_made_aliquots.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.873_lab_made_aliquots.md).
FTP only: no rules, index or function change (`allow create` on `inventory/{id}` already admits any lab member for a
non-stock item, `qty_*` included; `labels` and `labelQueue` creates are member-open).

### Added
- **+ Aliquot or lab-made** on `inventory.html` → `addLabMadeItem()` in `rm/js/inventory.js`: an `openForm` with
  *What is it?* (`aliquot` | `made_in_lab`, required), Name (required), Description (required), *Where it lives*
  (required; `<datalist>` from `_invLocationSuggestions()`, every location name already on an item; tidied by
  `_invTidyLocation()` — spaces around `/` collapse), optional *How many* + *Of what* (`LAB_MADE_UNITS`; counts are
  rounded, `LAB_MADE_MEASURES` mL/µL/g/mg are not), *Made on* (local date, `_invLocalToday()`), and *Send its labels to
  the lab's label printer* (default on). The doc is an ordinary `kind:'item'` with `lab_made: true`, `lab_made_type`,
  `category: 'lab_made'`, `subcategory` = the type, `made_by_uid`, `made_by_name`, `date_acquired`, `is_consumable:
  true`, `locations: [{name, quantity, notes}]`, `locIds: []`, `reorder: null`; with a count it is created tracked
  (`qty_tracked`, `qty_unit`, `qty_made` = `qty_remaining` = n, legacy `quantity` = n). Ids are
  `aliquot-<date>-<name>` / `lab-<date>-<name>`.
- **A QR code on every lab-made item at save** — `_invLabelNewItem(item, labels)` after the form closes: with the
  printer box ticked, `INV_LABELS.queue()` with one copy of the item per piece (a counted batch in a count unit, capped
  at `LAB_MADE_MAX_LABELS` = 100; otherwise 1), every label carrying the batch's one code; unticked,
  `INV_LABELS.ensureCode()` mints the code alone. A failure toasts and leaves the item (Print label in its panel).
- `_invCreateItem(vals)` — writes ONE `inventory/{id}` doc in a transaction that refuses an id already taken (slug,
  then `-2`, `-3`… up to 30; ids in the page's list are skipped without a read), `updatedAt` server time, then
  `api.invalidate(DATA_PATH)`, pushes the row and repaints. Local JSON dev (no `firebridge.db`) keeps the old save.
- `_invOpenItem(id)` — the V3.813 `?item=` opener factored out; also clears the category / stock filters and resets
  `_expandedRow` / `_expandedVariant` (after a re-render `toggleRow` would otherwise CLOSE a row id it still thinks is
  open). `_invPaintChrome()` — tabs, counts, category filter and table from memory, split out of `loadAndRender()`.
- A **Made in Lab** tab (`i.lab_made`) with *Aliquots* / *Made in lab* subtabs (`SUBTAB_LABELS`), `lab_made` in
  `CATEGORY_OPTIONS`. Row: `labMadeChip(item)` beside the name, `vendorCell(item)` → "made by <name>". Panel: an
  inline **Description** (`inlineTextarea(…, 'description', …)`, shown for any item that has one), "Made by / Aliquoted
  by <name> on <date>" in place of Date Acquired, no *Request reorder*.
- `rm/js/forms.js` (`openForm`, used across RM): optional `suggestions` (a `<datalist>` with a unique id) and `hint`
  (`.form-hint` line) on a field; `placeholder` on a textarea.
- `scripts/tests/v3873-lab-made-selftest.html` — 44 checks headless against the real forms / inventory-qty /
  inventory-use / inventory scripts (stub Firestore holding a colliding slug, stub `INV_LABELS`; `?demo=form` /
  `?demo=row` for screenshots). `inventory-labels.test.mjs` 18 → 19.

### Changed
- **+ Add Item** saves through `_invCreateItem` (one doc) instead of `api.save(DATA_PATH, _data)`, which re-set all
  ~3,500 inventory docs to add one (the V3.729 "+ New paper" shape), then opens the new item.
- The Qty column shows what is LEFT for a tracked item (`qtyCell(item)`: `qty_remaining` + unit); the legacy `quantity`
  never moves on a scan, so a batch would have shown its starting count forever.
- Search also matches location names and `made_by_name` — typing `fridge/box/001` lists what lives there.
- `INV_LABELS_CORE.storageFor(item)` falls back to the location names when the item has no storage field, so a
  `fridge/box/001` tube prints 4C rather than RT (a storage field still wins).
- `INV_USE.take`: no *Request a reorder* action on the low-stock toast for a `lab_made` item.
- `openForm`: a required field holding only whitespace is refused and the first empty one takes the focus; a failed
  save is a `TOAST.error` (`_formSaveFailed`) instead of `alert()`, which stays only where `toast.js` is not loaded.
- `sw.js` CACHE_VERSION 855 → 856; `CodeLog/features.json` `rm.inventory` summary.

### Bug Fixes
- Names, location names and descriptions are escaped in the inventory list and panel (`escAttr` in the name cell,
  `locationsChips`, the locations table, `inlineText`, `inlineTextarea`). A name like `LLS <50 µm` used to break the row
  and a `</textarea>` in notes broke the panel; members now type these names themselves.

## [V3.872] — 2026-10-23 — A task component in a Scientia note is an RM task, done flows both ways (Phase 1, step 3, web build)

Alex: *"continue."* Plan: [V3.872_scientia_tasks_rm.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.872_scientia_tasks_rm.md). `scientia/src` untouched;
the hub deployed before the client.

### Added
- **RM tasks on the hub** (`functions/scientia-hub-core.js`): `rmTaskFromBlock({uid, name, b, now})` — the document
  `TASK_ASSIGN.writeTaskFor` writes (`id 'task-<ts36>-<4>'`, `text`, `bucket: 'assigned'`, `status: 'pending'`,
  `done`, `done_at`, `due_date` YYYY-MM-DD | TBD, `priority` + `self_importance` high 2 / normal 0 / low −1, `notes`,
  `assignedToUid/Name`, `assigned_by_uid/name`, `created_at`, `source: 'scientia'`, `source_ref {scientia: {docId,
  blockId}, docTitle, projectName}`); `rmTaskPatch(u, now)` (text, due, prio, notes, done + done_at, updated_at);
  `planTaskSync({state, pairs, now})` — pure reconciliation of DONE per pairing: the later timestamp wins (block
  `task.done` / `modified` vs task `done_at` / `updated_at` / `updatedAt`) → an RM patch or a block op (`task.done`,
  `task.rmDoneAt`, a log entry `{via: 'rm'}`) pushed as device **RM tasks**; a block no longer a live task → the RM
  task is dismissed (`dismissed_at`, `dismissed_reason`) and unpaired; a task gone from RM → unpaired. Routes: `POST
  api/rm/tasks` (400 without `blockId`), `POST api/rm/tasks/update` (paired ids only), `GET api/rm/tasks?ids=`,
  `POST api/rm/tasks/sync`; `hello` / `state` run `syncTasks` quietly, throttled (`TASKSYNC_MS` 2 min).
  `MemoryHub` keeps `rmTaskDocs` / `rmTasks`. `isoAt(now)` accepts a Date or ms.
- `functions/scientia-hub.js` `FirestoreHub`: `_taskRef`, `_pairs` (the hub doc's `rmTasks: {taskId: blockId}`),
  `createTask` (idempotent per block; set + merge), `updateTask`, `getTasks` (`getAll`), `syncTasks` (`getAll` task
  docs + block rows, plan, push, patch, prune with `FieldValue.delete()`; `taskSyncAt`). **Deployed.**
- `rm/scientia/lab-mode.js` §6: `TASK.create` wrapped → `sendTask(b)` (`POST api/rm/tasks`, `b.rmTaskId`, repaint;
  one in flight per block); `TASK.save` → `updateTask` (text / due / allDay / prio when changed, 800 ms debounce,
  a signature shadow); `TASK.done` / `TASK.undo` → `update {done, doneAt}` at once; `TASK.body` → an **↗ RM** chip
  on a paired block (opens RM's Tasks) or **+ RM** on an unpaired one; `WIDGETS.task.body` re-pointed at the wrapper
  (the doc view had captured the original). `VIEWS.tasks` = RM's Tasks + the notebook's task components with their
  RM state, *Send N open tasks to RM*, *Open the note* / *Open in RM* / *Send to RM* per row. `SIS_LAB.tasks = {
  send, update, state, isPaired }`; `SIS_LAB.version` V3.872.
- 3 fixtures (hub 42/42) and 11 harness checks (`v3869-scientia-lab-mode-harness.html`, **50/50** on the real build;
  the stub gained the task routes and `__emit(op)` — a hub-doc listener wake + a pull that serves queued ops, so a
  block op from "RM tasks" is shown reaching the editor through the ordinary pull).

### Changed
- `rm/scientia/scientia.html` rebuilt; `sw.js` CACHE_VERSION 854 → 855; `CodeLog/features.json` `scientia.tasks`
  note; the V3.866 plan §3 status.

### Two facts the harness taught
- The app leaves an incoming op alone while its own change to that record is still in the outbox, and defers it
  while the block is being typed in — a test must push first (`SYNC.outbox.size === 0`) and blur.
- `WIDGETS.task.body` is a captured reference: wrapping `TASK.body` alone does not reach the doc view.

## [V3.870] — 2026-10-23 — Fix: the phone app crashed at launch on iOS 27 (adopt the UIScene lifecycle)

Gabe's crash log (iPhone 16 Plus, **iOS 27.0.1**, build 18): `EXC_BREAKPOINT (SIGTRAP)` 66 ms after launch in
`___UIApplicationEvaluateRuntimeIssueForNoSceneLifecycleAdoption_block_invoke` ← `-[UIApplication
workspace:didCreateScene:withTransitionContext:completion:]`, no app frame. iOS 27 refuses to launch an app built with the
iOS 27 SDK that has not adopted the UIScene lifecycle; Ourlab was still app-delegate-only (`UIMainStoryboardFile`) and is built
with Xcode 27.1. Every iOS 27 phone was affected; iOS 26 phones (Alex, Cason) only log a warning, and the simulator here was
iOS 26.5. The V3.867 theory (a page dying on Gabe's data) was wrong — no web code is involved.

### Bug Fixes — native (OurlabMobile, build 21)
- `ios/App/App/SceneDelegate.swift` (new, in the App target): `UIWindowSceneDelegate`; the window comes from
  `Main.storyboard`, so `TabShellViewController` is the root as before. `scene(_:willConnectTo:options:)` (cold-launch links),
  `scene(_:openURLContexts:)` and `scene(_:continue:)` forward to `ApplicationDelegateProxy.shared` exactly as AppDelegate's
  `application(_:open:options:)` / `continue userActivity` did.
- `Info.plist`: `UIApplicationSceneManifest` (single scene; `UISceneDelegateClassName = $(PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME).SceneDelegate`,
  `UISceneStoryboardFile = Main`); `UIMainStoryboardFile` removed.
- `AppDelegate.application(_:configurationForConnecting:options:)` → "Default Configuration".
- `OurlabDiagnostics.start()` also observes `UIScene.didActivateNotification` / `willDeactivateNotification` /
  `didEnterBackgroundNotification`.

### Tests
- iOS 26.5 simulator: the scene build opens to the sign-in screen, all four tab pages load, the marker reads `foreground`.
- iOS 27 simulator runtime: see the plan's test note — the pre-fix app (build 20 code) vs the fix.

Plan: [V3.870_ios27_scene_lifecycle.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.870_ios27_scene_lifecycle.md). Native only — no sw.js bump.

## [V3.869] — 2026-10-23 — Scientia on the web is RM-native (Phase 1): the lab's library mirrored into the notebook, Activity / Data / Tasks page replaced by RM's

The desktop app is untouched (`scientia/src` unchanged); everything is in the web build's lab layer and the hub.

### Added
- **The RM library mirror** (`functions/scientia-hub-core.js`): `rmItemToLibraryRow(item)` maps an RM paper (`items`,
  `type: paper`, `meta.library.is_library_entry`) to Scientia's library record — `id` = the RM item id, `rm: true`,
  `rmId`, `doi`, `cslType`, `title`, `authors[{family, given}]`, `container`, `year`, `volume/issue/page`, `issn`, `url`,
  `isPreprint`, a built `csl` (`_source: 'rm'`), `rmPdf`, `added`, `rmUpdated`; `pdf = 'rm:<id>'` when RM holds a PDF.
  `planMirror({state, rows, items})` → ops for the hub's own `push` (device `rm`, name **RM library**): new added,
  unchanged skipped (`MIRROR_FIELDS`), changed updated keeping desktop-owned fields (`pdf`, notes), papers gone from RM
  tombstoned, non-RM rows never touched. `route()`: `hello` and `state` mirror first (quietly, throttled);
  `POST api/rm/library/refresh` forces it; `GET api/rm/library/pdf?id=` → `{url}` (download-token URL for Phase 3).
  `MemoryHub.mirrorLibrary` mirrors `hub.rmItems`. `MIRROR_MS` = 5 min.
- `functions/scientia-hub.js` `FirestoreHub.mirrorLibrary({force})` (equality-only `items` query, the hub's `library`
  rows, `mirrorAt / mirrorN / mirrorWritten` on the hub doc) and `rmPdfUrl(id)` (reuses or sets the object's
  `firebaseStorageDownloadTokens`). **Deployed** (`functions:scientiaHub`) before the client.

## [V3.868] — 2026-10-23 — git keeps up with the site: the push hook, the merge checker, the feature registry, two deployers

Alex: *"ensure there is a hook for pushing git as well, and part of this hook is a merge checker, and part of this merge
checker is that we dont want overlap in capability … if gabe makes a feature that is close to something that already exists
it needs to be flagged to combination"*; then Gabe's FTP + Firebase access. Plan:
[V3.868_git_push_hook_merge_checker.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.868_git_push_hook_merge_checker.md).

### Added
- `CodeLog/features.json` — the **feature registry**: 64 features (RM, the parent site, Scientia, the shared layer) with
  `id`, `name`, `side`, `summary`, `keywords`, anchored `paths`, and the relations `extends` / `merges_into` (`status:
  retiring`) / `related` / `distinct_from {id: reason}`; `status: decision`, `desktop_only`; `feature_dirs` says where a
  new file counts as a new module. The V3.866 Scientia → RM mappings are encoded as `merges_into`.
- `scripts/merge_check.py` — the **push gate**: (1) registry lint (schema, dangling relations, every look-alike pair must
  declare a relation); (2) **overlap** — new files, Scientia `TABS` / `STORES` entries, RM nav items, widget
  registrations, function exports, `window.X` globals, `api/…` routes, UI labels and (in new scripts) top-level
  functions are tokenised and scored against every other feature's name + keywords + file stems (IDF-weighted; owner
  = the file's feature or a same-side feature that fits better; hit at ≥ 1.5 with a distinctive token, labels 2.0, or
  distinctive name tokens covering > ½ of an entry signal) and HELD with the fix spelled out — that is "flagged to
  combination"; lines added to a retiring feature warn; (3) **merge** — `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD`,
  conflicts hold with the file list; (4) **gates** — `node --check`, the Scientia build, the hub tests, the icon/emoji
  gate, each when its files changed. Commands `range` / `worktree` / `pre-push` (git protocol on stdin) / `ci` / `lint` /
  `queue` / `install`; `--target --no-fetch --no-merge --no-gates --json --quiet`; `MERGE_CHECK_DONE=1` skips a repeat.
- `.githooks/pre-push` — the tracked git hook (`python3 scripts/merge_check.py install` sets `core.hooksPath`).
- `.github/workflows/merge-check.yml` — the same gate on every pull request and push to `main` (so `--no-verify` and
  un-installed hooks are still checked), plus the Scientia build, hub tests and the checker's fixtures.
- `scripts/git_autopush.py` — the **git step of the Stop hook**, run BEFORE autodeploy: commit the turn (subject from the
  CHANGELOG head, `(cont.)` when the version continues, `Co-Authored-By` trailer under Claude) → fetch → rebase onto
  `origin/<branch>` (abort + HELD on conflict, commit kept local) → the push gate (its report lands in the turn's
  message) → push → rebuild Scientia when the rebase touched it. Guards: secrets/credentials/`.env`/payroll/ledgers/
  grant documents/rosters/bundles never staged (path patterns + content scan: private keys, service-account JSON, API
  tokens, `sck_` keys); > 50 MB; a batch above `autoPushMaxFiles` waits for `--batch`; `--dry-run`, `--status`;
  `autoPushAllow`; pause with `"autoPush": false` / `MCGHEELAB_AUTOPUSH=0`. One JSON `systemMessage` line.
- `scripts/deploy.py merge-manifest <base> <ours> <theirs>` — git merge driver for `deploy/manifest.json`
  (`.gitattributes`): union, newer `deployedAt` wins, a dropped file stays dropped.
- `scripts/tests/merge_check_test.py` — 31 fixtures in throwaway repos (registration, overlap, lint, merge conflict,
  pre-push protocol, install, autopush commit/guard/batch/gate/rebase/pause).

### Changed
- `scripts/deploy.py`: `load_dotenv()` reads `MCGHEELAB_FTP_USER` / `_PASSWORD` / `_HOST` from `scripts/.env` (a second
  deployer's own login); `git_guard()` — `ftp` and `autodeploy` are HELD when not on `deployBranch` (`main`) or behind
  `origin/main` (`--any-branch` overrides `ftp`; offline it steps aside); `scientia_build_if_stale()` rebuilds the web
  Scientia before hashing when a source is newer.
- `deploy/site.json`: `autoPush`, `autoPushMaxFiles` (80), `autoPushAllow`, `deployBranch`.
- `.claude/settings.json`: the Stop hook runs `git_autopush.py` then `deploy.py autodeploy`.
- `.gitignore`: `Data/payroll*`, `Data/transactions*`, `Data/*.csv`, `Data/*.xlsx`, `Data/Grants/`, vendor manual PDFs,
  `**/*.paperbundle.zip`. **`Data/payroll_all.csv`, `Data/transactions_all.csv`, `Data/Alex_McGhee_StartUp.xlsx` were
  tracked in the PUBLIC GitHub repo** — removed from the index (files stay on disk); the history purge is Alex's call.
- `scientia/CLAUDE.md`: the git workflow is now the hook-based one (install, branch, the gate, the registry, the
  batch push) and an **Access** section for Gabe (GitHub, Firebase Editor — done, FTP via `scripts/.env`).
  `rm/CLAUDE.md` + root `CLAUDE.md` point at it.

- `autoPushSkip` (deploy/site.json): paths the hook leaves for a hand push; the message names them each turn. The
  batch push (`791bda16`, 1,706 files) was first refused by GitHub for `.github/workflows/merge-check.yml` — the
  Keychain credential was an OAuth token without the `workflow` scope — so the file was skipped for that push. Alex
  then ran `gh auth refresh -s workflow && gh auth setup-git` and pushed it (`03a383fe`); the list is empty again. The
  Action's first run on `main` passed (21 s).

### Not in this version
- Branch protection on `main` (the Action exists now — require "merge check / gate"); making the repo private; purging
  the payroll/roster history; Gabe's FTP account itself (cPanel) — all Alex's.

## [V3.867] — 2026-10-23 — When the app won't open, it still gets the crash report out (native share, no page needed)

Alex: *"on gabes phone, the app doesnt even open"*. Build 17 broke the app for Gabe; it changed no native code and TestFlight
counts 0 crashes for him, so the likeliest failure is the first page (My Week) dying or hanging every time on his phone —
which V3.865 records on the phone but can only deliver THROUGH the page (upload, Share banner).

### Added — native (OurlabMobile, build 20)
- `OurlabDiagnostics.swift`:
  - `startupCheck()` — 25 s after the app first becomes active, if no page has called `claim()` (a working page does ~2 s
    after its HTML is parsed), write a `no-start` report (the marker, web deaths per tab) and prompt.
  - `webContentDied` keeps deaths PER TAB (`webDeaths: [String: [Date]]`); the same tab dying 3 times in 90 s = a crash
    loop → prompt. (iOS can take every page down at once and they recover — that is not a loop.)
  - `promptToShare(reason:)` — ONE native `UIAlertController` per run ("Ourlab isn't starting properly … Send it to the
    lab?" — **Not now** / **Send report**), only while active and only with pending reports; Send report opens
    `UIActivityViewController` with every pending report file. Files stay pending, so a page that recovers still uploads.
    `topViewController()` walks the key window's presented stack.
  - A previous run that ended while `launching` (same build) is reported too: "Ourlab closed while starting". A launch in the
    background (push / fetch) starts as `background`, so it never reads as a start-up crash.

### Changed — web
- `rm/js/app-diagnostics.js` boots on `DOMContentLoaded` (was window `load`, which waits for remote images and fonts) — the
  native watchdog reads a claim as "this page is alive", and a slow network must not look like a page that never started.

### Bug Fixes
- `rm/js/my-week.js` `monthGridDays(dateStr)`: a malformed date made the day loop endless (`'NaN-NaN-NaN' <=
  'NaN-NaN-NaN'` is always true), growing an array until the page's process died. Falls back to `localToday()` and stops at
  42 days. Latent — My Week validates its date today, so this is NOT shown to be Gabe's cause.

### Tests
- v3865 harness 22/22. Simulator: a working page with an old report waiting → its own banner, NO native alert at 32 s; the
  page processes killed three times 8 s apart → the native alert (screenshot); a hand-seeded `launching` marker → "Ourlab
  closed while starting". `monthGridDays` with `TBD` / `''` / `undefined` → 35 days in ~1 ms.

Plan: [V3.867_app_wont_open_reports.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.867_app_wont_open_reports.md). sw 850 → 851.

## [V3.865] — 2026-10-23 — The phone app writes its own crash report, sends it to the lab, and shares it in one tap

Alex: *"gabe has an iphone 16+ — can we make it so if the app crashes it can log a detailed report, so he can share the
crash data without having to type anything"* (build 17 "crashes on Gabe's phone" with no TestFlight report to go on).

### Added — native (OurlabMobile m-v0.5.0, build 19)
- `ios/App/App/OurlabDiagnostics.swift` (new, in the App target): `OurlabDiagnostics.shared.start()` from
  `AppDelegate.didFinishLaunching`.
  - **MetricKit** (`MXMetricManagerSubscriber` + `pastDiagnosticPayloads`): payloads with crash / hang / CPU-exception
    diagnostics become `native-crash` / `hang` / `cpu` reports carrying Apple's `jsonRepresentation()` and a one-line cause
    (`EXC_BAD_ACCESS · SIGSEGV · <ObjC exception> · <termination reason>`); deduped in `seen-metrickit.json`.
  - **Unclean-exit marker** `state.json`: `phase` foreground / inactive / background (`didBecomeActive`, `willResignActive`,
    `didEnterBackground`; removed on `willTerminate`), active tab, each tab's last page (`note`), memory warnings. A launch
    that finds `foreground` from the SAME build writes an `app-exit` report with the previous run's marker.
  - **`DiagnosticsNavigationTap`**: a forwarding `WKNavigationDelegate` in front of Capacitor's `WebViewDelegationHandler`
    (installed in `TabBridgeViewController.capacitorDidLoad`, retained there); `webViewWebContentProcessDidTerminate` writes a
    `webcontent` report (tab, URL) — or only counts it when the app is in the background — then Capacitor reloads as before.
  - Device facts on every report: model identifier, iOS, physical / available memory (`os_proc_available_memory`), thermal
    state, Low Power Mode, free disk, memory warnings and background web deaths this run.
  - Plugin `OurlabDiagnostics` (per bridge): `claim()` (each report to ONE webview per launch), `done`, `release`, `info`,
    `note({page, active})`, `share({filename, text})` (UIActivityViewController with the report file).
- `scripts/sync-rm.mjs` injects `<script src="/rm/js/app-diagnostics.js">` near the top of every app page's `<head>`.

### Added — web
- `rm/js/app-diagnostics.js` (app only; inert on the website and in builds without the plugin): breadcrumbs in
  `localStorage` `ourlab.crumbs.v1` (80; page loads, tab shown / hidden, `error`, `unhandledrejection`, `console.error`, taps by
  action name / id / label — never typed text; a repeating error is one crumb with a count); on the VISIBLE tab
  (`__OURLAB_TAB_VISIBLE`) it claims the reports, attaches the breadcrumbs from before each event, uploads them to
  `crashReports/{id}` (MetricKit + event as JSON strings — Firestore cannot hold nested arrays), then `done` / `release`
  (signed out: released at once — `firebridge.getUser() === null`). Banner for crashes / stopped pages: "Ourlab closed
  unexpectedly last time." / "A page stopped and reloaded." with **Share report** (the share sheet) and ×.
- `rm/pages/app-reports.html` (admin): newest first — kind, cause, when, who, phone model name, iOS, build, free memory;
  open one for the breadcrumb timeline, the event and Apple's report; **Copy for Claude**; two-tap Delete.
- `firestore.rules` `crashReports/{reportId}`: create by the signed-in owner (`uid == auth.uid`, `id == reportId`, fixed
  field list, `kind` ≤ 40 chars), never updated, read / delete by admins. **Deployed** from a scratch copy = the LIVE
  ruleset + this block only (the repo file's V3.806 users guard and V3.835 inventory `use_mode` hunks were NOT shipped);
  `:test` API 9/9 (owner create; other uid / id mismatch / extra field / signed out / update denied; admin read + delete;
  reporter read denied); live re-read == the deployed copy.

### Tests
- `scripts/tests/v3865-app-diagnostics-harness.html` (new) 22/22 — breadcrumbs, no typed text, error de-dup, claim → upload →
  done, the rule's field list, MetricKit as a string, banner + Share, a failed upload released and retried, a hidden tab
  waits, signed out hands back at once, inert outside the app.
- Simulator (Debug build of this tree): killing the page processes → four `webcontent` reports (one per tab) + the banner;
  `simctl terminate` and `kill -SEGV` in the foreground → `app-exit` with the tabs' last pages; a kill after going to Settings
  (background) → no report. MetricKit itself only delivers on a device.

## [V3.863] — 2026-10-23 — Cards mode replaces Text (move and edit cards); on a phone, a Pan · Select · Pen · Highlight bar, and no keyboard until you edit text

Alex: *"instead of a text tool, it should be a card moving and editing tool"* and *"on the lab notebook mobile, the keyboard is
in the way most of the time. the keyboard should only pop up if we are modifying text. we need to have the pan, select, pen,
highlight tools as separate clickable modes so users can navigate the canvas without the keyboard showing up."*

### Changed
- `whiteboard.js` — the ✎ pill's first arc is zoom · pan · pen · highlighter · **cards** (`hand-card`, icon `cursor-arrow-rays`);
  `HAND_MODES` / `HAND_NAMES` gain `card`, lose `text`. Text mode is removed: `placeTextAt`, `isEmptyNote`, `TEXT_SIZES`,
  `TEXT_TINTS`, the `text-size` / `text-tint` actions, `S._textTapT` (new notes come from ＋ and from the Cards arc).
- **Cards mode** (`S.tool === 'card'`, root `.wb-hand-card`): `bindItemHandlers` makes the whole card the handle (`.wb-items >
  .wb-item` media items too, lifted above the ink); a drag arms after 8 px; a tap calls `cardSelect(id)` (`S.cardSel`, class
  `wb-card-sel`, body live). With a mouse the caret goes where you clicked (`cardFocusAt(id, x, y)` via `elementFromPoint` +
  `caretRangeFromPoint`); a touch / stylus only chooses — unless the card was already chosen (then the tap edits). A press inside
  the chosen card's body is the card's own. The empty board pans (`onPointerDown` → `S.panDrag`); a tap on it, Escape (capture
  listener on the card), leaving the mode (`trackMode`) or removing the card lets it go.
- Cards' second arc (`pillItems('pens')`, group `card`): chosen → `card-edit` (`cardEdit`), `card-color` (`toggleTintPop`,
  notebook), `card-collapse` (regions: `toggleRegion`), `card-front`, `card-more` (host `onMenu`; phone → sheet settings),
  `card-remove` (two taps; `cardRemove` runs the host's own Remove from `widgets.menuItems` so its clean-up runs, else
  `deleteItem`), `card-done`; nothing chosen → `card-note` (`cardAddNote`: a note mid-view, chosen, caret in it) and `zoom-fit`.
- Handle: `selectCard(id)`, `selectedCard()`; `handMode()` returns `'card'`.

### Added — the phone (`.wb-m`)
- **Mode bar** (`modeBarHTML()`, `MODE_BAR`, rendered by `renderPills` when `mobile()`): Pan · Select · Pen · Highlight, words +
  monochrome icons, the lit one `wb-sel`; a tap on the lit one opens the ✎ fan (its options); `Undo` joins while pen /
  highlighter is in hand. A phone STARTS in Pan (`S._phoneMode`).
- **Pan goes through the cards:** `.wb-m.wb-hand-pan|zoom|pen|hl|eraser .wb-widgets *{pointer-events:none}` (and
  `@media (pointer: coarse)` in Pan on any touch screen); `bindItemHandlers` returns early on a phone outside Select, and for a
  touch in Pan on wider screens. `bindLensHandlers`: one finger scrolls / pans for the drawer too in Pan and Cards (`handPans`).
- **A finger draws on a phone:** `inksHere(e)` accepts `touch` when `mobile()` and the tool is pen / eraser; `S.active.ptr` —
  only that pointer adds points or ends the stroke; a second finger calls `cancelTouchInk()` (finishes + `removeStrokes` the
  first finger's stroke, stops erasing) and the stage's pinch / pan takes over.
- Select on a phone keeps V3.852's behaviour (a tap opens the card's sheet, a drag moves it); the sheet never focuses a field.

## [V3.862] — 2026-10-23 — Fix: the 📖 Paper card "cannot connect to the library" (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'db')`)

### Bug Fixes
- `rm/js/canvas-paper-reader.js`: `db()` / `me()` / the profile read used `window.firebridge`, which is ALWAYS undefined in
  production — `firebase-bridge.js` declares `const firebridge`, a bare global, not a window property. Every library read on the
  Paper card (search, annotation watch, PDF re-check) threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'db')`, and `uid()` was
  empty. New `fb()` = `(typeof firebridge !== 'undefined' && firebridge) || window.firebridge || null`; `db()` throws "the sign-in
  bridge did not load" when it is missing. (V3.856 bug, carried through V3.859; harnesses missed it — see Changed.)

### Changed
- Canvas harnesses `v3833`, `v3837`, `v3852`, `v3854`, `v3856`, `v3859`, `v3860` are production-shaped: after the stub,
  `const firebridge = window.firebridge; delete window.firebridge;`. Serving the pre-fix module through request interception makes
  v3856 stop at 0/4; with the fix: 44 · 42 · 36 · 65 · 35 · 64 · 33, plus v3839 77 · v3842 43 · v3830 26 green.

Plan: [V3.862_paper_card_firebridge_fix.md](../ClaudesPlan/V3.862_paper_card_firebridge_fix.md). sw 844 → 845.

## [V3.861] — 2026-10-23 — Monochrome icons everywhere: no colour-emoji pictures left in the UI

Alex: *"go through the entire site, and ensure the icons we use are the solid color type not the colored images i
really dont like that. look everywhere and replace with a standard library"*. Plan:
`CodeLog/ClaudesPlan/V3.861_monochrome_icons_everywhere.md`. V3.642 converted the chrome and stopped by design; ~200
versions later a scan of every shipped file found ~1,450 colour emoji outside comments in 192 files, because nothing
failed when one was added. They are all gone, and now something fails.

### Added
- **Lucide gap icons** — `vendor/lucide/24/` (Lucide 0.469.0, ISC, repo root like `vendor/heroicons/`): 60 icons
  Heroicons has no shape for (atom, droplet, brain, rat, fish, keyboard, flask-conical, test-tube, pipette, thermometer,
  dices, bomb, cylinder, git-fork, highlighter, save, bot, square-parking…). `gen-icons.mjs` reads `lucide: true`
  entries; the root `stroke-width` is dropped like Heroicons', so `.hi` draws both at one weight.
- `scripts/icons.manifest.json` 100 → **207 icons**, 136 → **263 glyphs** mapped for `ICON.render()` / the kill
  switch; new Heroicons (calculator, cloud, pause, stop, x-circle, microphone, printer, puzzle-piece, map, phone,
  bug-ant, scissors, fire, heart, film, arrow-up-tray, arrow-uturn-right…); custom `dot` (solid disc); `tint{}` maps
  colour-shape glyphs (🔴🟠🟡🟢🔵🟣🟤⚫🔶🔷🔺) to a tinted solid `dot` / `diamond` / `triangle`. Remapped: 🧮 → calculator
  (was variable), 🧪 → test-tube (was beaker); 🅿 left `keep{}` for `square-parking`.
- `rm/js/icons.js` (generated): `ICON.svg(name, {tint, attrs})`; `ICON.render()` draws tint glyphs and strips U+FE0F;
  `ICON.hydrate(root)` swaps static `<i data-hi="name" data-hi-variant/-size/-label/-tint>` (runs at DOMContentLoaded);
  `ICON.draw(ctx, name, x, y, size, color, {variant})` paints an icon on a canvas with Path2D (synchronous); a
  `#hi-base` style with the `.hi` rules is injected first in `<head>` so a page without the site stylesheet never paints

- `scripts/module_icons.py <file…> | --all [--check]` — course modules stay self-contained (AUTHORING.md §0): an inline
  `<symbol>` sprite of exactly the icons a module references + `HI.svg()` / `HI.draw()`, between `hi-icons` markers
  after `<body>`; refuses a module that declares its own `HI`. AUTHORING.md §7.7 documents it.
- `gen-icons.mjs --emoji` — fails on any colour emoji (Extended_Pictographic except ↔↕↖↗↘↙©®™, including ones written
  as `\u{…}` / surrogate-pair / `&#…;` escapes) outside comments in every shipped JS/HTML/CSS/JSON file

## [V3.860] — 2026-10-23 — The ✎ pill: a first arc of modes (zoom · pan · pen · highlighter · text), a second arc of the selected one's options; a double tap goes back to the last mode

### Revised (same day, before release) — the two arcs
Alex: *"the first arc should be zoom, pan, pen, highlighter, text — the second arc should be the options for the thing selected
in the first arc."*
- `whiteboard.js` `pillItems('pens')`: the inner ring (exactly five places) is `hand-zoom` · `hand-pan` · `hand-pen` · `hand-hl` ·
  `hand-text` (`keep: true`, so choosing one re-draws the fan with its options); the second ring onward is `handGroup()`'s
  options — **zoom**: in · out · home · fit everything · fit a region; **pan**: home · fit everything; **pen**: the pens of kind
  `pen` + the eraser of the set, widths, ＋ pen, undo, clear; **highlighter**: the `hl` pens, widths, ＋ highlighter, undo;
  **text**: `TEXT_SIZES` S / M / L (card width .22 / .32 / .46 — a note's type scales with its width) and `TEXT_TINTS` (plain +
  three card colours), `text-size` / `text-tint` actions (`keep`).
- Modes are `handOf()` = `zoom` · `pan` · `pen` · `hl` · `eraser` · `text` (a pen in hand is `pen` or `hl` by its kind);
  `HAND_MODES`, `trackMode`, the root classes and the double tap use it. `setHandMode('pen')` always puts a real pen
  (`S.lastPenId`, kind `pen`) in hand, `'hl'` the last highlighter (`S.lastHlId`, created if the set has none); `usePen` records
  both. `HAND_NAMES` words for the caption.
- **Text mode**: a tap — finger, mouse or stylus — places a typed-note card (`placeTextAt`: `addWidgetItem({ kind: 'note' })`
  at the tap, sized and tinted from the options) with the caret in it (on a phone, its sheet) once `DOUBLE_MS` has passed; a tap
  away from one you just placed and left empty removes it instead (`isEmptyNote`); a double tap places nothing and switches.
  `onPointerDown` returns early in text mode; `tapUp` now returns `'double'` · `'tap'` · `false`. Cursor `text`.
- Icons: the first arc, the pill's mode icon and the option glyphs use the site's monochrome set through `wbIcon(name,
  fallback)` (`ICON.svg` — magnifying-glass, hand, pencil, highlighter, plus, minus, home, arrow-uturn-left; a serif "T" for
  text); the mode caption is words. `node scripts/gen-icons.mjs --emoji` → 0 colour emoji.
- `whiteboard-board.css` — `.wb-hand-hl` / `.wb-hand-text` cursors, `.wb-fan-T` (+ `-s/-m/-l`), `.wb-fan-dot-none`, icon size in
  the fan and pill.
- Tests: `v3860-pen-pan-zoom-harness.html` 36 checks (arcs, rings, each mode's options, highlighter, text placement / take-back
  / double tap, the eraser and pen hand-back); V3.839 (77) and V3.833 (65) updated for the pen arc; V3.854's row check reads the
  words the icon sweep left; every canvas harness page now loads `rm/js/icons.js` as production pages do (the sweep made the
  card renderers call `ICON.svg`). All green: 77 · 65 · 43 · 35 · 64 · 33 · 44 · 42 · 26 · 36. `sw.js` → 844.

### First version (shipped earlier the same day)

Alex: *"the pan button and zoom should be in the pen as a mode, the mouse is either a pan hand, zoom hand, or pen. double tap
changes modes to last mode used"*. Plan: `CodeLog/ClaudesPlan/V3.860_pen_pan_zoom_modes.md`. Host boards only (the lab notebook
and a paper's figure board); the lecture whiteboard's toolbar is untouched.

### Changed
- `whiteboard.js` — **the hand's modes** live in the ✎ pill (`PILL_DEFS.pens` "Pen · pan · zoom"): its fan starts with
  `hand-pen` · `hand-pan` · `hand-zoom` (`.wb-fan-modeitem`, the current one selected), then the pens; the View pill (⊕) keeps
  zoom ± / home / fit / fit a region and no longer carries ✋ / 🔍. The pill's icon is the mode (✎ + ink dot, ✋, 🔍) and it lights
  (`wb-pill-on`) in pan / zoom / eraser. `trackMode()` (every pill render) remembers the previous hand mode in `S.lastTool`
  across `pen` · `eraser` · `pan` · `zoom` (region tools don't count) and sets `.wb-hand-{pen|eraser|pan|zoom}` on the root;
  `setHandMode(t)` (back to the last real pen — `S.lastPenId` — when an eraser from the set was in hand; an eraser from the set
  when going to the eraser); `toggleLastMode()` (default pen ↔ pan) + `showModeHint` (a caption at the bottom of the board,
  "✋ Pan — double-tap to switch back").
- **The zoom hand**: `onPointerDown` in zoom mode starts `S.zoomDrag` instead of zooming at once; a drag up / down zooms smoothly
  about the press point (`exp(-dy/180)`); a tap zooms ×1.5 (Alt / Shift / right button: out) after `DOUBLE_MS` (300 ms) so a
  double tap can cancel it, and then clears the last tap so tap · tap · tap zooms three times.
- **Double tap → the last mode**: `tapDown` / `tapUp` (any pointer type, called from `onPointerDown` before the ink filter and
  from `onPointerUp` after the stroke is committed): two taps within 300 ms and 24 px (each < 300 ms, < 8 px). A finger: any mode.
  A mouse: pan, zoom and pen — in pen mode the two dot strokes those taps made are removed (`removeStrokes`). A stylus: pan and
  zoom only (two quick pen taps are a colon or an ellipsis). Never a mouse / stylus in eraser mode. On the ✎ pill a double tap
  switches too: a single tap opens the fan 230 ms later unless a second arrives, so the fan never flashes; the ✎ pill's
  double tap no longer resets its position — **Tools → ⌖ Put the pills back in their places** (`pills-reset`, shown once a pill
  has moved) does, for every pill.
- Handle: `setHandMode(t)`, `toggleLastMode()`, `handMode()`, `lastHandMode()`.
- `whiteboard-board.css` — cursors (pen crosshair, pan grab / grabbing, zoom zoom-in, ns-resize while dragging), the mode ring,
  `.wb-modehint`.

### Tests
- `scripts/tests/v3860-pen-pan-zoom-harness.html` — 24 checks: the fan order and the View pill; pan (cursor, icon, drag pans,
  no ink); a mouse double-click back to the pen with the hint; the ✎ pill's double tap vs a single tap; the zoom hand (tap waits,
  ×1.5, Alt-tap out, drag up / down, a double tap does not zoom); pen mode: a mouse double-click switches and leaves no dots, a
  stylus double tap stays as ink, a finger double tap switches; eraser remembered; back to a real pen.
- V3.839 (fan count 13 → 16; the pill-reset check moves to Tools; ✋ from the ✎ pill) and V3.833 (zoom pill items; ✋ via the ✎
  pill) updated. All canvas harnesses green (76 · 65 · 43 · 35 · 64 · 33 · 44 · 42 · 26 · 24).
- `sw.js` → 843. No rules / functions change.

## [V3.859] — 2026-10-23 — One 📑 Collection: quotes, lit reviews and collections become one card; a paper without a PDF is no longer a dead end

Alex: *"quote, lit review, and collection cards can probably be combined … a single system."* — *"1) yes, lit reviews must be
linked to the paper we are writing, and we can connect multiple papers we are writing to any collection. 2) one per section yes
so the user can split up claims an ideas 3) no these can be separate things."* — and, live: *"when i try to search for a paper
to add, it says its not connected to the library"*. Plan: `CodeLog/ClaudesPlan/V3.859_collections_unified.md`.

### Changed
- `rm/js/canvas-paper-reader.js` — **one card for everything that comes from a paper.** `kind: 'collection'` data gains
  `keyPoints[]`, `notes_html`, `query`, `drafts[{id,title}]`, `linkedPairs['paperId|draftId']`, `shape: 'quote'`; entries gain
  types **`paper`** (`paperEntry(pid, p)`: title, cite, year, journal, `why`) and **`quote`** (a typed passage + citation). Two
  shapes from one renderer: **quote** (`isQuoteShape`: one `quote` / `highlight` entry and nothing else → `renderQuoteShape`, the
  editable `textarea.nbc-quote-in.cpr-qcard-in` + citation, or a read-only blockquote with a reader link) and **list** (split
  banner · claim head · *Linked to* chips · Papers (`.cpr-prow[data-pid]` with a "why it matters" input) · typed groups (a `quote`
  entry is editable in place) · Key points (`[data-kp]`, Enter opens the next) · Notes · the inline library search
  (`.cpr-search-in`, results `.cpr-results [data-add]` under it) · ＋ Key point · ＋ Note · ❝ Quote · ✎ Link to a paper you're
  writing… · ◆ Make this a claim…). Every write goes through `patchData(id, patch | fn(currentData), { refresh, title })`, so a
  wire landing while you type is never overwritten, and listeners hang on the card's own root (V3.856's body listener
  accumulated one handler per render). `entryFor` turns a wire from a 📖 Paper card's own side port into a `paper` entry, and
  no longer stores large inline thumbnails (> 6 kB) in the card.
- **The old kinds are adopted, never on render.** `paperquote`, `quote` (figure board) and `litreview` stay registered (hidden
  from ＋ Insert) and render through `asCollection(it)`; the first edit runs `adopt(it)` — a lit review's first section stays in
  the card (titled "<review> — <section>"), sections 2…N become new collection cards **below** it with deterministic ids
  `<id>_s2…` (two tabs adopting the same review write the same docs), then the card is rewritten to `kind: 'collection'`.
  `committer(it)` restores focus and caret after the rebuild. A multi-section review shows "Split into N collections".
- **Collections link to the papers you are writing** (decision 1). `openDraftPicker` (my drafts: `papers where authorUids ∋ me`;
  on a figure board the board's paper too) → `linkDraft`; a figure-board collection is linked to its paper from birth
  (`hostDrafts()`); making a claim links the claim's draft. `syncDraftLinks(id)` (queued, busy-guarded) calls
  `LIBRARY_LINKS.toggleDraftLink(paperId, draftId, true)` once per pair for every library paper the collection touches and
  records `linkedPairs`; `unlinkDraft` removes the pairs this collection made unless another collection / `litref` on the
  board holds them. Removing a card keeps its links (you may still cite those papers).
- **Mirror** `userData/{uid}/litReviews/{itemId}` (the V3.838 path) is written for every notebook collection by `mirrorNow`
  (`kind, itemId, title, boardId, entryId, query, paperIds, keyPoints, papers, entries (≤ 60, light), counts, claim, drafts,
  draftIds`), on change (`onItemsChanged` keeps a per-card signature, first sight only seeds it) and after adoption /
  `addQuoteCard` / `addLitReview`; `onRemoveItem` deletes it. `linkSourceToDraft(mirror, draftId, title)` records a figure-board
  placement on the mirror (`draftIds` arrayUnion) and the notebook card (`data.drafts`). `mirrorSubline(r)` is the picker line.
  `toHtml(it)` feeds the block mirrors (PMR).
- `rm/js/notebook-canvas.js` — the `paperquote` / `litreview` registrations, `renderPaperQuote`, `renderLitReview`, `litMirror`
  and `litMirrorDelete` are gone (the module owns them); the picker's highlight and "Add as text" → `addQuoteCard`; 📚 on a
  note's words → `addLitReview` (searches at once); `widgetToBlock` `case 'collection'`; Remove → `onRemoveItem`;
  `onItemsChanged` → the module's; ctx `mirror: () => ({ uid, boardId, entryId })`.
- `rm/js/figure-board-canvas.js` — the `quote` registration and `renderQuote` are gone; the picker's quotes → `addQuoteCard`; the
  📚 tool is "Add a collection from your notebook": the ones linked to this paper first (✎), ◆ for claims, `mirrorSubline` counts;
  placing one calls `linkSourceToDraft`; the placed card shows a claim badge and the counts line; `onChange` → the module's.
- `rm/pages/notebook.html` loads `library-links.js`; both canvas pages load `library-upload.js`.
- `rm/css/canvas-paper-reader.css` — quote shape, papers, typed passages, key points, notes, the inline search, the quiet foot,
  linked-draft chips, the split banner, `.fbc-lit-claim`, the no-PDF box.

### Bug Fixes
- **"Not connected to the library" (Alex, live):** the library search itself was healthy (read-only check of production: all
  242 library papers come back), but **98 of them have no stored PDF**, and choosing one left the 📖 Paper card at "No PDF in the
  library" with no way forward; the card also froze the PDF state at pick time. Now `noPdfBoxHTML` / `wireNoPdf`: the card
  re-checks the library item (`livePdf`, 30 s cache) and adopts a PDF found there since; **⤓ Find an open-access PDF** runs the
  reader's own `LIBRARY_UPLOAD.serverFetchPdf(item)` (Unpaywall / arXiv / Europe PMC / Semantic Scholar / publisher, server-side)
  and **⬆ Upload the PDF** `LIBRARY_UPLOAD.uploadPdf`; both write `meta.library.pdf` on the library item (`setLibraryPdf`,
  allowed by the V3.309 library-entry rule) so the reader and every other card see it. The library search names what was
  searched when nothing matches, says a PDF-less paper "can get one on the card", and a failed load offers **Try again**.

### Tests
- `scripts/tests/v3859-collections-unified-harness.html` — 42 checks: old kinds render without writes; typing adopts a quote and
  keeps the caret; Split → two collections + mirrors, idempotent; library load failure → Try again; a no-hit search names the
  term; no-PDF card offers Find / Upload, a lost PDF is picked up, Find writes the library item; draft linking (picker, chips,
  link calls once per pair, a wired highlight and a wired Paper card, unlink takes back its links); key points / notes / a typed
  quote; a claim preselects the linked draft and gets the evidence; menu, summaries, `toHtml`, mirror fields, `linkSourceToDraft`.
- Harness pages V3.833 / V3.837 / V3.839 / V3.842 / V3.852 / V3.854 now load the shared module; V3.833's lit review steps drive a
  collection. All green (65 · 35 · 75 · 43 · 64 · 33; V3.856 44; V3.830 28).
- No rules, indexes or functions change. `sw.js` → 842.
